name: pi-agent-webui
description: Local debug harness for PI Agent — DeepSeek-Harness-inspired sessions, chat, plugins, and trajectory.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --dir backend dev" "pnpm --dir frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend build && pnpm --dir frontend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir shared typecheck && pnpm --dir backend typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend typecheck
